purpose: Three local same-input trials to quantify observed transport interruptions separately from generation latency and paired public connectivity.
auth: Existing local signed-in ChatGPT Pro only; no Platform/caz keys.
condition: Historical urllib HTTP1.1 client, original payload, same proxy, single model call at a time, one attempt per trial, no automatic retries, no robot/Jev/SSH.
control: Per-trial unauthenticated HTTPS robots.txt control over the same proxy/domain; starts before the model, requests every20seconds and once after model return; log same socket, request latency/status/errors and matching proxy chain.
measurements: HTTP terminal chunk and low-level truncated-read/reset/TLS errors
paired public latency and failure timeline
classification: Only observed incomplete HTTP/network responses count as transport interruption. Local deadline and explicit service errors are separate. A transport interruption alone does not prove a local network fault; mark the closing hop unresolved without evidence. No exact percentage of wall-time caused by networking can be inferred from client waiting alone.
admission: All3predeclared trials retained; no replacements or prompt/model changes between them.
privacy: Event metadata and allowed response headers only, no reasoning text/credentials. Completed method output may be retained unexecuted.
